title.narrative: T2P - Multiplying and Scaling the Impact

description.narrative:
Overall Goal: To strengthen a resilient and sustainable cross-border community of young Palestinians and Israelis by leveraging high-tech and entrepreneurial training as an incentive for peacebuilding, cooperation, and professional development. The project fosters deep relationships and mutual understanding, enabling participants to create joint initiatives and advocate for coexistence in their professional lives.
Project Summary (Year 2 Focus): The second year (Oct 2024 – Sep 2025) focused on successfully implementing an MFA-approved regional hybrid model in response to ongoing conflict and movement restrictions. Core activities included the flagship Cyprus International Seminar and 28 distinct regional events, reaching a highly diverse, balanced cohort. This strategic adaptation ensured programmatic continuity, utilized previously carried-over funds, and maintained the project's core mission of deep, structured cross-border engagement.

The program's core objectives for Year 2 focused on programmatic resilience and the continuity of cross-border engagement. We successfully implemented the MFA-approved hybrid model, primarily to overcome severe movement restrictions stemming from the regional conflict. Key outcomes include engaging 182 unique beneficiaries and executing 28 distinct events (seminars and community gatherings). We maintained critical demographic balance with 50.0% female participation and equitable engagement across communities. This work facilitated intensive dialogue that resulted in reported shifts in empathy and mutual understanding among participants. Financially, the project successfully utilized a formally approved $80,000 carry-over from Year 1 to fully fund high-cost international activities, ensuring all funds were expended in line with the project's strategic goals.
